title: Cranston, RI police network intrusion, Nov 21, 2026

subject.name: Cranston Police
subject.about: The Cranston Police Department is the police force of the City of Cranston, Rhode Island. It says it provides police services to the city's residents and visitors.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by the Cranston Police Department, the FBI, the Rhode Island State Police, any news outlet, government agency, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One city police department's network, taken offline as a precaution. Police say phones, radio and calls for service were not affected. No count of records or people is given.
who_is_affected: The Cranston, Rhode Island police department and, if its database held it, the data in that database. Police say there is no indication personal information was accessed.

not_known.text: Whether the intrusion succeeded and what kind of attack it was.
Whether a ransom was demanded, or any personal data taken.
